other_conditions: Applicant must be widowed, divorced, or unmarried
Applicant must belong to a religious minority community as defined in the Government Order
Family member should not be a State/Central Government employee
Applicant or family members should not have availed benefits under any other scheme (excluding the Arivu Scheme) of the KMDCL in the last 5 years
benefits_summary: Provides a total financial assistance of ₹50,000, comprising ₹25,000 loan and ₹25,000 subsidy.
